vocabulary.meaning_en: to let a liquid (or rice, sugar...) fall out by accident; the mess it makes
vocabulary.example: He spilled his tea on the floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean a surface gently with a cloth or paper
vocabulary.note_ar: حركة خفيفة لتنظيف شيء غير متّسخ كثيرًا
vocabulary.note_en: A soft movement for light dirt.
vocabulary.example: Please wipe the table after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of soft material used for cleaning
vocabulary.example: I cleaned the window with a dry cloth.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean with water and soap
vocabulary.example: Wash your hands before you eat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the bowl in a kitchen or bathroom with taps, where you wash things
vocabulary.example: Put the dirty dishes in the sink.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that washes clothes
vocabulary.example: The washing machine is in the bathroom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clothes that need washing or have just been washed
vocabulary.example: I have a big pile of laundry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean something hard with a brush because it is very dirty
vocabulary.note_en: We scrub floors, sinks, toilets and walls.
vocabulary.example: She scrubbed the floor with a brush.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool with hairs or bristles for cleaning
vocabulary.example: Use a brush to clean the bathroom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean a hard floor with a broom
vocabulary.example: I swept the kitchen floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a brush with a long handle for sweeping floors
vocabulary.example: The broom is behind the door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean carpets with a machine that sucks up dirt; the machine itself
vocabulary.example: I vacuum the carpets every Saturday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft floor covering, usually from wall to wall
vocabulary.example: The bedroom has a blue carpet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small carpet that covers only part of a floor
vocabulary.example: There is a small rug next to the bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a stick with strings or cloth for washing floors; to clean with it
vocabulary.example: Mop up that water before someone slips.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an open container with a handle for carrying water
vocabulary.example: Fill the bucket with warm water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that dries clothes
vocabulary.example: Put the wet clothes in the dryer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to bend clothes or paper neatly so they are flat
vocabulary.example: Please fold the towels.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something back in its usual place
vocabulary.example: Put the plates away in the cupboard.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to wash with clean water to remove soap
vocabulary.example: Rinse the dishes after you wash them.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that washes dishes
vocabulary.example: We put the cups in the dishwasher.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things you throw away
vocabulary.note_ar: trash أمريكية، garbage كندية وأمريكية، rubbish بريطانية
vocabulary.example: The garbage smells bad; let's take it out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: jobs you do at home without pay, like washing dishes
vocabulary.example: I have chores to do before I go out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: fine grey dirt on furniture; to clean it off
vocabulary.note_en: dust bunny = a small ball of dust
vocabulary.example: I dust the shelves once a week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short way of saying something long
vocabulary.example: "Do the dishes" is shorthand for washing, drying and putting away the dishes.

fine_lines.title: wipe vs scrub
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wipe مسح خفيف بقطعة قماش للأوساخ البسيطة. scrub فرك قوي بفرشاة للأوساخ الصعبة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Wipe = clean gently with a cloth (light dirt). Scrub = clean hard with a brush (heavy dirt).

examples.sentence: Wipe the table with a cloth.
Scrub the toilet with a brush.

fine_lines.title: sweep vs vacuum vs mop
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sweep بالمكنسة اليدوية للأرضيات الصلبة. vacuum بالمكنسة الكهربائية للسجاد. mop بالممسحة والدلو للسوائل والأرضيات المبلّلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sweep hard floors with a broom. Vacuum carpets and rugs. Mop wet floors and spills.

examples.sentence: Sweep the sugar off the kitchen floor.
Vacuum the carpet in the living room.
Mop up the water you spilled.

fine_lines.title: carpet vs rug
fine_lines.explanation_ar: carpet يغطي الأرضية كلها من جدار إلى جدار. rug سجّادة صغيرة تغطي جزءًا فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A carpet covers the whole floor, wall to wall. A rug covers only a small area.

examples.sentence: The whole room has a grey carpet.
There is a round rug under the table.

expressions.meaning_en: wash, dry, fold and put away clothes
expressions.example: I can't go out; I have to do the laundry.

expressions.meaning_en: wash, rinse, dry and put away the dishes
expressions.example: It's my turn to do the dishes tonight.

expressions.meaning_en: collect the rubbish, tie the bag, take it outside and put in a new bag
expressions.example: Can you take out the trash, please?

expressions.meaning_en: clean up liquid with a mop
expressions.example: Get a mop and mop up this mess.

expressions.meaning_ar: عندي أعمال منزلية يجب أن أنجزها.
expressions.example: Sorry, I can't come; I've got chores to do.

expressions.meaning_en: make a place clean and tidy
expressions.example: Let's clean up the kitchen after lunch.

grammar.title: Shorthand phrases with "do": do the laundry, do the dishes
grammar.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية نستخدم do مع بعض الأعمال المنزلية لنختصر عدة أفعال: do the laundry تعني نغسل الملابس ونجففها ونطويها ونرتبها. do the dishes تعني نغسل الصحون ونشطفها ونجففها ونرتبها. ونستخدم take out مع the trash.
grammar.explanation_en: English uses "do" with some chores as shorthand for many steps: do the laundry (wash, dry, fold, put away), do the dishes (wash, rinse, dry, put away). With rubbish we say "take out the trash".
examples: He takes out the trash every evening.

questions.question: Water is on the kitchen floor. What should you use?
To clean a carpet, you ___ it.
The toilet is very dirty. You need to ___ it with a brush.
questions.explanation_en: Scrub = clean hard with a brush.

questions.question: "I'm doing the laundry" means I'm ___.
questions.explanation_ar: do the laundry = غسل الملابس وتجفيفها وطيّها.
questions.explanation_en: Laundry = clothes; do the laundry = wash, dry and fold them.

questions.question: A small carpet that covers only part of the floor is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A rug is a small carpet.

questions.question: After washing dishes with soap, you ___ them with clean water.
questions.explanation_en: Rinse = wash with clean water to remove soap.

questions.question: Which word means "housework you don't get paid for"?
Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation_ar: الصحيح: take out the trash وdo the dishes وdo the laundry.
questions.explanation_en: We say take out the trash, do the dishes, do the laundry.

questions.question: You ___ a hard floor with a broom.
"Oh no! I ___ my tea on the table."
questions.explanation_en: Spill = let liquid fall by accident.
